Rationale: the choice between repair 1 (declare the dep as `devDependencies: workspace:*`) and repair 2 (delete/rewrite the sole stale example) is lane discretion — neither expands the accepted set or the public surface, so no maintainer decision is needed. Note for the services seat: whichever repair, coordinate the `UNCHECKED_SOURCE_DEBT`/`RECONCILED` ledger edit with the in-flight #10756 gate work (same instrument, fold-or-serial to answer at claim time). — triage seat, session `session_016N5bHZr1DG4g9RK7v36YtV`

- serial constraint: `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/examples/` + `package.json`. ⚠️ PR #11004 (card #10859) is open on `src/register-sso-provider.ts` in the same package and touches **no** manifest and **no** lockfile — verified against its file list. No conflict expected; do not touch its files.

## Why this is dispatchable when the card says "Not choosing here"

The filer declined out of scope discipline, not because the choice needs a ruling. "Is this example a working reference or is it stale?" is answerable by measurement — whether the hono pairing is a documented supported pattern, whether anything references the file, whether the API it demonstrates still exists. Measure it and choose. If the measurements genuinely do not separate the two, report `needs_decision` rather than picking to make the card closeable.

## ⚠️ The trap: repair 1 as written is unverifiable

The card presents "add the dependency" and "rewrite or delete" as the two repairs. **Adding the dependency does not put `examples/` into any tsc program.** `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/tsconfig.json` selects `include: ["src/**/*"]`, and that is unchanged by a manifest edit — so after repair 1 the example still compiles in **no** program, `pnpm typecheck` still ignores it, and **nothing verifies that the fix worked**.

That matters twice over:

- you would be shipping a repair whose only evidence is that you typed the right package name;
- and the defect could silently return, because the blind spot that hid it (#10756's census: this is the census's single instance of source in **no** tsc program at all) is untouched.

So if you take repair 1, you must also produce a **real compile of that file** — either by widening the program, or by an explicit `tsc` invocation over it that you run and report. Reproduce the card's original error first (`TS2307`), then show the same invocation clean. A fix with no reproduction of the failure it fixes is not measured.

## ⚠️ The ratchet interaction — and a correction to how the card states it

The card says: *"putting the directory in a tsc program means deleting that entry — which `RECONCILED` forces."* That is right, but it applies **only if you widen the program**, not to a bare manifest edit. Be precise about which case you are in:

- **manifest edit only** → `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/examples` stays in `UNCHECKED_SOURCE_DEBT` (`scripts/check-type-check-coverage.mjs`); do **not** delete the entry, because the directory is still unchecked and a stale entry is its own failure.
- **widen the program** → the entry must be deleted in the same PR, and `check:type-check-coverage` will tell you so. Run it and quote its verdict line either way.
- **delete the example** → say explicitly what happens to the entry, and check whether the directory ceases to exist (an entry naming a directory that is gone is also stale).

⛔ Do not delete a debt-ledger entry to make a gate quiet. Every ratchet in this repo is shrink-only *because the plugin was repaired*, never because the entry was inconvenient.

## Standing proof standard

Reproduce the `TS2307` on the current tree **before** editing — the card measured it at `5886ee6d22` and the tree has moved; if it no longer reproduces, say so and stop. Ablation with the signature predicted first, restore proved byte-identical by `git hash-object`. Zero-hit counter-check with a positive control on the same corpus. Gate union derived on the **final** commit, clean tree, `dispatch-gates.mjs` with **no path arguments**, exit codes captured before any pipe. Class #10309 is live — run what you judge relevant explicitly and say whether the derivation named it. Changeset required. Draft PR only.

⚠️ A `pnpm --filter` that matches no script exits **0** having run nothing — echo the script name so a zero-match cannot read as a pass. An unwired script name exits **254** and reads GREEN through a pipe. Never `git stash` (shared stack). Never report a grep hit count as a fact count.

⛔ Do not touch `content/docs/releases/**` or `packages/spec`.

## Refs

#10756 (the census that surfaced it, and the blind spot itself) · `scripts/check-type-check-coverage.mjs` (`UNCHECKED_SOURCE_DEBT`, `RECONCILED`) · #10615 (a standing plugin-auth TEST_DEBT surplus — **not yours**, do not run `--lower`)
